native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'bargraph1': 'A1 on, others off', 'rgb1': 'red', 'rgb2': 'blue'}, 'description': 'After initial 0.5 seconds, the bar graph should have LED A1 lit (first segment), rgb1 should be red, and rgb2 should be blue because A1-A4 are active.'}

test2: {'time': 4, 'state': {'bargraph1': 'A3 on, others off', 'rgb1': 'red', 'rgb2': 'blue'}, 'description': 'After 3.5 more seconds (total 4 seconds), the bar graph should have LED A3 lit (third segment), rgb1 should be red, and rgb2 should be blue because A1-A4 are still active.'}

test3: {'time': 10, 'state': {'bargraph1': 'A6 on, others off', 'rgb1': 'green', 'rgb2': 'yellow'}, 'description': 'After 6 more seconds (total 10 seconds), the bar graph should have LED A6 lit (sixth segment), rgb1 should be green, and rgb2 should be yellow because A5-A8 are active.'}

test4: {'time': 18, 'state': {'bargraph1': 'A2 on, others off', 'rgb1': 'red', 'rgb2': 'blue'}, 'description': 'After 8 more seconds (total 18 seconds), the bar graph should have LED A2 lit (second segment, after restarting from A1), rgb1 should be red, and rgb2 should be blue because A1-A4 are active again.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
